import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from runner import *

fails = []
def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((name, got, want))
        print("FAIL", name); print("   got :", json.dumps(got)); print("   want:", json.dumps(want))
    else:
        print("ok:", name)

def m(**kw):
    base_m = {"host_probe_tx":0,"network_ping_tx":0,"network_ack_tx":0,"host_ack_tx":0,
              "deduplicated_ping":0,"capacity_drops":0,"late_ping":0,"ignored_ack":0,
              "allocations":0,"cache_peak":[],"peak_entries":0,"end_us":0}
    base_m.update(kw); return base_m

# T1: host ACK delivery strictly after cache release is still delivered
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=1,ack=1,label="a"), edge(1,2,ping=1,ack=1,label="b")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=3, host_delay=10)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T1.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":2,"source_complete":True,
    "host_delivery_us":12,"source_proof":[0,1]}])
expect("T1.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=2, network_ack_tx=2, host_ack_tx=1,
    allocations=3, cache_peak=[1,1,1], peak_entries=3, end_us=12))

# T2: reverse ACK arriving well after release -> entry absent -> ignored_ack
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=1,ack=1,label="a"), edge(1,2,ping=1,ack=5,label="b")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=3)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T2.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":3,"source_complete":False,
    "host_delivery_us":4,"source_proof":[]}])
expect("T2.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=2, network_ack_tx=2, host_ack_tx=1,
    ignored_ack=2, allocations=3, cache_peak=[1,1,1], peak_entries=3, end_us=7))

# T3: PING exactly at the deadline is on time; capacity 0 at that node drops it
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=3,ack=1,label="a"), edge(1,3,ping=1,label="b"), edge(0,2,ping=3,label="c"),
         edge(2,3,ping=1,label="d")]
d = base(n=4, capacity=[3,0,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=3)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T3.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":3,"source_complete":False,
    "host_delivery_us":4,"source_proof":[2,3]}])
expect("T3.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=4, network_ack_tx=2, host_ack_tx=1,
    capacity_drops=1, ignored_ack=1, allocations=3, cache_peak=[1,1,1,1], peak_entries=4, end_us=4))

# T4: launch near the contract maximum; deadline/release/host-delivery arithmetic
edges = [edge(0,1,label="a"), edge(1,2,label="a")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges,
         rounds=[rnd(launch=1000000000, timeout=1000000, host_delay=10000)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T4.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":1000000004,"source_complete":True,
    "host_delivery_us":1000010004,"source_proof":[0,1]}])
expect("T4.metrics.end", res["metrics"]["end_us"], 1001000001)

# T5: capacity release frees entries before same-timestamp PING (priority order)
edges = [edge(0,1,label="a")]
d = base(n=2, capacity=[1,5], edges=edges,
         rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=4), rnd(launch=5, timeout=4)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T5.starts", [r["started"] for r in res["rounds"]], [True, True])
expect("T5.alloc", (res["metrics"]["allocations"], res["metrics"]["capacity_drops"],
     res["metrics"]["peak_entries"], res["metrics"]["end_us"]), (4, 0, 2, 10))

# T6: dedup PING to unfinalized destination entry (before finalization) -> single ACK covers both parents
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=2,label="p"), edge(0,2,ping=2,label="q"),
         edge(1,3,ping=2,ack=3,label="r"), edge(2,3,ping=2,ack=3,label="s")]
d = base(n=4, capacity=[2,2,2,2], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=100)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("T6.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":12,"source_complete":True,
    "host_delivery_us":13,"source_proof":[0,1,2,3]}])
expect("T6.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=4, network_ack_tx=4, host_ack_tx=1,
    deduplicated_ping=1, allocations=4, cache_peak=[1,1,1,1], peak_entries=4, end_us=101))

# T7: timeout at deadline finalizes source; ACK credited exactly at deadline comes first (priority)
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=1,ack=1,label="a"), edge(1,2,ping=1,ack=2,label="b")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0, timeout=4)])
res = run_ok(d)
# t=0 source, t=1 node1, t=2 node2(dest) -> finalize true -> ACK on e1 arrives node1 at 2+2=4 (== deadline)
# node1 credits at t=4 (prio 3) -> finalize true -> ACK on e0 arrives node0 at 4+1=5 -> but source
# timed out at 4? no: node1 ACK is at t=4 -> the source's ACK arrives at 5 -> source timed out at
# 4 (prio 4) BEFORE the ACK, so source finalizes complete=False keeping proof from node1's ACK? none yet.
expect("T7.round", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":4,"source_complete":False,
    "host_delivery_us":5,"source_proof":[0,1]}])
expect("T7.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=2, network_ack_tx=2, host_ack_tx=1,
    ignored_ack=1, allocations=3, cache_peak=[1,1,1], peak_entries=3, end_us=5))

print(); print("FAILURES:", len(fails))
for f in fails: print(f)
